cohort: Women with axial spondyloarthritis and a general population comparator group matched 1:10 on year of delivery, maternal age, and parity in Sweden between April 1, 2007, and December 31, 2020
finding: Women with axial spondyloarthritis had increased risks of preterm birth, pre-eclampsia, elective caesarean delivery, and serious infant infection compared with the general population.
mod_finding: The risk of caesarean delivery decreased by around 0.5 percentage points annually during the study period.
